steps.note: S1.1 asserts that scratch wires return to their arbitrary initial values and quotes the lemma statement (line 729), but never gives the row-by-row computation that the net target change (JV+RG)x does not depend on the initial scratch values.
The plan has no central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, no side-wire cancellation of intersection-one cases and no self coefficient one; S1.3.1 only gives <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1, which is a different fact.
The plan never states the complex-case central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 or the side-wire cancellation of intersections zero and two.

S1.1 states forward/backward/forward with net exchange up to sign and scratch restored, but not the intermediate maps (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x); this asserts the lemma's result without the stage computation (S1.5.4's D-H, H+D, H-D updates are a different, tape-level step).
No residual table or per-edge orthogonal residuals and dimensions appear; the plan says only that labels are nested (S1.3) and later uses P_V-P_U for nested labels (S1.3.4.1).
The plan does not treat the side edge 2->5: S1.3.1 notes neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal, but there is no <t_X> inside t_Y^perp argument and no complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2.
S1.3.2.1-3 state the only decreasing edges are center 3->4 losing h, telescoping with sources N and sinks Wm-N giving signed Wm-2N, L=Ich, and absolute change adding 2L, with S1.3.2 giving Wm-2N+2L.

The plan never states that each nonzero binary residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating or that it has an orthonormal basis (absorbing alternating planes); S2.1 merely uses 'an orthonormal basis of the edge residual' as given.
S1.3.3 gives L_b/N=100/539 but the plan never states L_c/N=101/539 for the complex network, so only half of the defining content is present.

S2.1 only says edge frames are products of translation kernels over an orthonormal basis of the residual; it does not give weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors or the identity q_V-q_U=sum wt(v)[v.x].
The plan names the kernel aI+bX_v (S2.1) but omits the oddness of wt(v), the phase i^{eps[v.x]} and the H diag(1,-1) H = X conjugation that produces the translation kernel.
No statement that on k columns each residual vector gives one tensored factor with s_c factors in all; S2.1 mentions s<Wm factors but not the column tensoring.

S2.1 only says that after corrections the endpoint operator is C^{⊗m} on every role; the zero/full label frames, the C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates, the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} repair with C=iZC^{-1}Z, and the negated X outputs are not stated.
S1.3.3 gives L_b/N=100/539<1/2 and S1.3.4/S1.3.4.3 give deficit N-2L>0 because L<N/2, hence s=Wm-N+2L<Wm.
The plan never states eta_b=339/22587335000000.
The plan never states eta_c=73/19906842167500.
S1.3.5 states that the deficit exceeds 20*2^-50 and log m<20, so tau=1-2^-50 gives s/W<m^tau, and S5.1 sets tau=sigma=1-2^-50 (the m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-eta) chain itself is only quoted, not spelled out).

S1.4/S1.4.1 state the factorization A=E1 Pi E2 with Pi having a ones (quoting the lemma statement, line 1366) but give no elimination proof: no pivot at the topmost row's rightmost entry, no clearing by lower-triangular operations, no repetition on active indices.
The plan has no fixed odd prime avoiding denominators in a finite table of factors and no specialization of the identities to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.

S1.4's explicit motivation says lower triangular changes of coordinates are done in tape order in linear time because a later field is updated from earlier fields (the 'descending physical order' detail is not spelled out, but the O(V) claim and its reason are stated).

S1.4.3 says each one of Pi calls for H_i<-H_i+D_j, done by two controlled updates around exactly one interchange of H_i and D_j, so the number of interchanges is a (explicit update formulas are not written out).
S2.7 mentions C_0 and C_1 only as symbols in the fractional-bit count; E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3}, C_0=128mB^2 and the values nu=11, C_1=20 are never defined.

The plan has no arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with A(e)<=8e at a leaf and no per-invocation operation count below E; S2.6.2's recurrence is the time recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+..., a different quantity.
No unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, or bound below C_0 d^{C_1}; S2.7 only asserts the resulting p+ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) fractional bits.

S2.7 states p+Delta fractional bits with Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) and O(p) width from epsilon*C_1<1, but omits the depth-l induction (values in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^l) and the Delta+3 integer bits that make the reservation exact, so it asserts the result without the derivation.
S2.8 states that every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disk arrays map to disk arrays and the single truncation errs by less than sqrt2*2^-p.

summary: P06 carries the label-budget bookkeeping (L3), the loss ratio and rank deficit (R1), the exponent step tau=1-2^-50 (R4), the triangular-cost and one-interchange-per-one parts of the shear lemma (M3, M4) and the row-sum-one disk argument (S5). It states results without their derivations elsewhere: the scalar exchange proof (B1-B4), the residual table and binary orthonormal bases (L1, L2, L4), the whole phase-interface proof (P1-P4), the eta values (R2, R3), the elimination proof and prime choice (M1, M2) and the guard-width constants, depth recurrence and unrolling (S1-S4). L5 is half present (only L_b/N=100/539). 6 of 26 present.
